subject.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat

question: Should ordinary Oracle browser runs enforce Chat mode by resetting confirmed non-resume Work tabs and rejecting confirmed Work resumes?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish that the implementation works, but they cannot decide whether this user-facing session and upgrade behavior is the repository's intended permanent contract.

options.title: Approve Chat-only normalization
options.body: Adopt the current positive-evidence reset and fail-closed resume behavior for ordinary Oracle browser runs.

options.title: Preserve Work sessions
options.body: Keep mode detection non-destructive until Work execution is supported or users can explicitly select the desired policy.

recommendation.title: Approve Chat-only normalization
recommendation.body: Adopt the current positive-evidence reset and fail-closed resume behavior for ordinary Oracle browser runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser startup, navigation history, and recent integration work make steipete the strongest available owner for this behavior contract.
